The '''Puurrgerr''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clan from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. When [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was sold to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Ssoh]], he was put in one of Ssoh's ships holding cells. The Puurrgerr, [[Grrobahrr]], and [[Chevappa]] clans were also in the cell. They questioned him at first but soon allied with him, broke out, took over the ship, and almost killed Ssoh.
